review.recipe: Single narrow small stemmed sour glass; cloudy pale golden bourbon/lemon sour, tiny bubble ring, bare rim no ice/garnish/egg-white foam.
review.personality: Crumb discreetly removed onto napkin, facedown handled hand mirror, source's private considerate correction at dinner. Lemon shell and worn muddler support method. Recomposition brings traces together and shrinks glass.
review.world: Historic walnut reading room, burgundy chair, single warm right lamp; neutral deep surround and observed texture.
